issue.description: sase v0.18.0 is on PyPI and `pip install sase` works again. payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: bugyi-chops just check still fails 4 toobig_split tests on clean master — `_assert_planned_prompts_use_lumberjack_wait_runners` expects `%queue(runners=3)` which sase 0.17.0 plan_chop_proposals no longer emits; tracked by sase-1gn. ci_watch lint/mypy/92 tests/build passed.

Implemented the athena cadence_driver: ci_watch now reads vars.heavy_dispatch_every_hours (0/absent = off) like other per-repo release settings and, independently of merge/incidents, applies the dispatch rule to each repo's heavy_workflows on the default branch via a bounded `gh run list --workflow` query (not the shared all-workflow window). Live mode runs `gh workflow run`; dry-run reports would-dispatch. Last dispatch is persisted per repo/workflow with a 15-minute cooldown. Failures are summary+report only and do not flip release eligibility. chezmoi sase_athena.yml sets heavy_dispatch_every_hours: {sase-org/sase: 2} and updates the mutation-allowlist descriptions. Verified: bugyi-chops just lint, just build, and 92 test_ci_watch.py tests (due, not-due, each in-flight status, cooldown, dry-run, disabled, dispatch-failure leaves merge untouched, per-workflow isolation). sase axe job doctor: configured scripts resolve (pre-existing WARN for unconfigured sase_job_tg_inbound). just check still fails 4 toobig_split tests on clean master (sase-1gn). Deployment is phase release.
